name: agent-loops
description: An agent graph for development (tech lead, implementer, tester, reviewer) and the feedback loop that makes it improve itself.

plugins.name: lead
plugins.description: Tech-lead orchestration: break a task down, then run implementer, tester and independent reviewer agents, and record what each stage caught.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: The self-improvement loop: mine run records and session transcripts for recurring mistakes, promote fixes up a ladder (note, instruction, hook, test), and check that each rule actually worked.
